name: magecut-local
description: Local video editing, captions, animation and export in the full Magecut browser editor.

interface.shortDescription: Edit local video with a full timeline.
interface.longDescription: Windows x64 local video editor. Lightweight plugin; first launch downloads the full editor and Node.js with retry, resume and SHA-256 verification. No Electron or separate Node installation required.
defaultPrompt: Edit a video and save an editable project.
